name: Sonic similarity
author: Thilo Utke
description: Similar tracks, Instant Mix and weekly mood playlists from audio analysis by the navidrome-sonic sidecar

http.reason: Query the navidrome-sonic sidecar, a private address on the Docker network

matcher.reason: Resolve a track ID to the file size, duration and title the sidecar looks it up by, and mood results to the tracks a user can open

library.reason: Navidrome requires it for the matcher; no filesystem access

users.reason: Build mood playlists for each user the plugin is granted, from the libraries that user can open

subsonicapi.reason: Find, create and refill each user's mood playlists
